Yes, you're likely covered. Leafy Plus members get a **90-day** Plant Care Guarantee from delivery, and root rot counts as significant decline. At 60 days you're within the window, provided the plant was ordered while your membership was active.

To claim, go to "My Orders" and submit at least **two photos** (whole plant plus a close-up). A Plant Care Specialist will review within **2 business days**, and you don't need to send the plant back. If approved, you'll get one free replacement (or store credit if it's out of stock).

Note that the guarantee doesn't cover pests introduced after delivery, deliberate neglect, or repotting into non-Leafy soil in the first 14 days. If any of those apply, the claim could be affected.
